jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Program Manager, Product & Marketing Operations

**Location:** Yonkers, NY (Hybrid ) or Remote  
**Reports to:** Senior Director of Operations

**Salary:** $110-$130K

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing haircare brand built on culture, community, and results. As we scale across DTC, TikTok Shop, retail, and experiential channels, we require a highly disciplined Project Manager to drive end-to-end execution across new product development, marketing campaigns, and retail initiatives.

This role enables timely, accurate execution through clear ownership, integrated planning, early risk identification, and verified launch readiness.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager, Product & Marketing Operations to translate business priorities into completed product launches, marketing campaigns, and cross-functional business initiatives. Reporting to the Senior Director of Operations, this person personally builds and drives integrated project plans, resolves dependencies and blockers, holds owners accountable for commitments, and verifies that deliverables are approved, implemented, and complete.

This is a hands-on senior program management role accountable for integrated planning, proactive problem solving, and delivery across functions. The Program Manager challenges missed commitments, secures recovery plans, and escalates decisions with options and business impact, enabling execution without repeated follow-up.

The ideal candidate has personally managed physical consumer product launches and integrated marketing campaigns in a fast-paced environment, coordinating Brand, Operations, Supply Chain, Social, E-commerce, CRM, Paid Media, and external partners. The role owns planning, dependencies, delivery tracking, escalation, and completion verification. Functional leaders retain ownership of strategy, staffing, technical and creative quality, and approvals within their areas.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Project Ownership (Product + Campaigns)**

* Own execution for:
  + New product development (concept formulation packaging launch)
  + Marketing campaigns (sales, seasonal launches, partnerships, retail activations) and assigned cross-functional business initiatives, including channel launches and operational implementations
* Proactively manage projects end-to-end, identifying risks early and escalating when necessary with clear solutions
* Secure owners and delivery commitments, define completion criteria, and verify acceptance by the receiving team. Track missed commitments through recovery and closure.

**2. New Product Development (NPD) Execution**

* Manage full NPD lifecycle:
  + Concept and kickoff
  + R&D and formulation coordination
  + Packaging development
  + Labeling, claims, and compliance
  + Sampling, testing, and approvals
  + Launch readiness
* Ensure all SKUs, variants, and components are fully scoped from the start
* Coordinate across R&D, Ops, Supply Chain, Brand, and manufacturers

**3. Marketing Campaign Execution**

* Manage execution of:
  + Sales campaigns
  + Retail launches and activations
  + TV segments, influencer campaigns, and partnerships
* Ensure all assets, timelines, and deliverables are aligned across channels
* Coordinate with Social, Brand, E-commerce, and external partners

**4. Structured Project Kickoff & Scope Definition**

* Lead formal kickoff for every project to confirm scope, owners, dependencies, approval gates, and open decisions
* Define and validate scope during kickoff and planning:
  + All SKUs
  + All deliverables and assets
  + All timelines and dependencies
* Validate critical scope and launch requirements with stakeholders before execution; document assumptions and assign owners and deadlines for unresolved decisions
* Identify missing SKUs or deliverables early; manage approved scope changes and communicate their effect on timing, resources, and launch readiness

**5. Timeline & Critical Path Management**

* Build and maintain detailed timelines in project management tools
* Manage critical path across product development and campaigns
* Track dependencies and ensure alignment across teams
* Build backward plans using realistic lead times, approval gates, and resource availability; surface conflicts early and secure recovery actions when dates are at risk

**6. Retail & Launch Readiness**

* Ensure products and campaigns are fully launch-ready across:
  + DTC, including website and app
  + Retail and marketplaces, including Amazon and TikTok Shop
  + Media
* Confirm all requirements are completed before launch:
  + Packaging, labeling, compliance
  + Assets and approvals
  + Operational readiness

**7. Risk Management & Proactive Problem Solving**

* Identify risks early across all projects
* Communicate issues before deadlines are impacted
* Present solutions and recovery plans with accountable owners, revised dates, tradeoffs, and decisions required; escalate unresolved conflicts to the Senior Director of Operations
* Prevent execution breakdowns and last-minute scrambling

**8. Execution Accuracy & Attention to Detail**

* Ensure accuracy in:
  + Dates and timelines
  + Asset naming and organization
  + Campaign details and logistics
  + Product scope and SKUs
* Validate critical information, document assumptions and decisions, and resolve uncertainty proactively

**9. Asset & Deliverable Coordination**

* Track all creative and product assets (video, photo, copy, packaging)
* Verify completion through receiving-team acceptance, documented approvals, and launch-day checks. Confirm approved assets, listings, offers, links, and campaign components are implemented correctly across applicable channels. Track outstanding issues through resolution.
* Obtain and document signoffs from authorized functional approvers before external submissions. Track labeling, claims, and compliance review without acting as the technical or regulatory approv

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist (Cleared)
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside in New York or DC and be able to commute to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

**Clearance and Eligibility**
-----------------------------

This role requires an active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance. United States citizenship is required, because it is a condition of eligibility for the clearance the role depends on.

**The Role**
------------

You'll own the full implementation journey for Kaizen's federal customers: scoping the rollout, configuring the platform, training agency staff, and staying in the room until the deployment is actually adopted, not just launched. You'll work inside classified and accredited environments where every integration decision has to account for what data can move where, and you'll partner closely with the engineering team to make sure what gets shipped actually fits how the agency operates.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own end-to-end federal implementations: discovery, scoping, configuration, data migration, integrations, training, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Lead onboarding for agency stakeholders and career staff, translating what they actually need into a rollout plan that survives contact with a live agency.
* Work inside classification and data-handling constraints as a design input, not an obstacle, coordinating closely with engineering on what can be built and how.
* Translate patterns from the field back to Product and Engineering: edge cases, workflow gaps, and the things agencies never put in the RFP but need on day one.
* Act as the connective tissue between customer-facing implementation and the engineers building, so what ships matches what was promised.
* Build the playbooks, templates, and internal documentation that make the next federal deployment faster than this one.
* Guide public sector partners through the actual change management of replacing a legacy system, not just the technical cutover.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3+ years in SaaS implementation, onboarding, solutions engineering, or a product-adjacent delivery role (Implementation Consultant, Solutions Architect, Technical Program Manager), with a track record of owning multi-stakeholder rollouts.
* Technical fluency: comfortable working with APIs, data models, and system configurations, and able to hold your own in a conversation with engineers about integration tradeoffs.
* Experience translating customer requirements into implementation plans and technical workflows, not just a status tracker.
* Comfort operating inside classified or otherwise accredited environments, or a clear ability to pick up new compliance and data-handling constraints fast.
* A bias toward action: you'd rather build the process while running the deployment than wait for someone to hand you one.

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* Have deployed software inside a classified or accredited environment before and know where the real friction lives.
* Have touched federal, state, or local government implementation work specifically, versus enterprise SaaS generally.
* Have built implementation playbooks or internal tooling from scratch at an early-stage company.

**Don't Apply If...**
---------------------

* You need a mature playbook to follow. Most of what you'll use here, you'll be building.
* You want to hand off the hard technical questions to engineering and stay on the process side. This role lives at that intersection.
* You're looking for a steady-state customer success role. This is deployment under real constraints, with real agencies, and real consequences if it goes wrong.
* Government bureaucracy and slow-moving stakeholders would wear you down instead of something you know how to work with.
* The agencies you'll be deploying to serve people who don't have another option if the system doesn't work. That's the weight of this one.

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch whil

jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team that plans, builds and operates the datacenter infrastructure that powers Microsoft’s global cloud services. CO+I delivers the secure, resilient and scalable infrastructure that enables customers, partners and businesses around the world to rely on Microsoft’s cloud platforms every day.
